scoring_coverage.note: G4's literal text ('every record under deterministic_scoring') FAILED for the 60 published identifiability probe records: --probe trained and scored them outside deterministic_scoring() and they store no scoring policy. The frozen G4 computation, over the rollout records, passes and is unchanged; this failure is reported separately. By owner decision (2026-10-16) the frozen cascade (a failed guard turns every token into readiness_or_precision_insufficient) is not applied: the readiness and rollout tokens stand. Every identifiability verdict carries this G4 qualification and its reproducibility result: all probes were retrained and re-scored under deterministic_scoring() with the frozen features, seeds, folds and k (probe-reproducibility/), reported beside the published records, not swapped in
